q1_issues.issue: "in Friday's edition" is slotted as Location, but a publication is a textual container, which the instruction set routes to the preposition-named oblique (its own "'in a statement' likewise In" example), so Location asserts a spatial position the sentence does not state.

q2_gaps: a temporal 's-possessive on a non-eventive noun ("Friday's edition"): the genitive rule assumes an entity possessor (PartOf / Possession), while calendar times exist only as structured Time-role terms on eventualities, so a date-modified artifact noun has no licensed form
notes: The parse fills that gap by hanging (Time sk_edition_1 (Weekday friday)) on the edition witness, i.e. a Time role on a non-eventuality. Ordinal with the associated-event scale, the Possession genitive, and the named paper left un-typed (no invented kind atom) all follow the instruction set.
